description: List Cloud Run services in a given Google Cloud project and region.

inputSchema.description: Request message for retrieving a list of Services.

project.description: Required. The project ID or project number to list the Services from.

region.description: Required. The region to list the Services from.

name: list_services

ServiceListOutput.description: The output of a managed Cloud Run Service in the result of list services response. It only contains a subset of fields of the service.

lastModifier.description: Email address of the last modifier.

name.description: The fully qualified name of this Service. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/services/{service_id}

uri.description: The main URI in which this Service is serving traffic.

outputSchema.description: Response message containing a list of Services.

project.description: The project where the Services are listed from.
